review.scientific: Internal review of factor identities and cellular synthesis, tissue factor initiation, XII laboratory/physiology distinction, vitamin K/Gla, membrane-bound complexes, thrombin feedback, fibrin and XIII, platelet contraction, antithrombin, TFPI, protein C/S, lysis, assay and mixing interpretations. Compared historic 1964 cascade papers, cell-based model, endothelial FVIII knockout evidence and clot compaction study. Reviewed all 55 correct option mappings and rationale; balanced answer position counts 14/14/14/13. Recomputed INR 1.5, saturation 0.75 and 6, both triangular areas 500, three half-lives 12.5%, and fibrin net accumulation 3 mg/min then zero. Hypothetical data identified.
review.editorial: Separate pass reviewed 12 progressively organized teaching sections; expanded historical and evidence paragraphs, corrected diagrams to parallel pathways rather than sequential trigger, revised 16 traps with reasoning and added revision terminology/equations/curriculum links. 134 distinct teaching paragraphs, 55 explained questions, 12 active recall, 20 reference entries, inherited reader shell and dynamic neighbor navigation.

score_basis: Internal judgment, not external certification.
